node.title: Prize N=256 profile-(3,6) sharp product window
node.closure: analytic extremum reduction plus exact rational certificate
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, every profile-(3,6,S=18) collision with cofactor 1024 or 1028 has variance in {4,6,8,10,12}. The sharp fixed-mean/fixed-variance product envelope excludes all even V from 14 through 34 by 649 exact rational comparisons.
node.notes: ROUTE CONTRACTION 2026-07-28: the two shortest profile-(3,6) cofactor windows contract from V<=34 to five low-energy chambers. The exact certificate also proves that this envelope alone does not remove V=12.
